title: An R Toolkit for the Micheli Guide to Fungal Conservation Policy Gap Assessment
text: MicheliR Shiny‑based R package automates keyword‑search evaluation workflow Micheli Guide Fungal Conservation (CBD Evaluation Form). performs deterministic keyword counting (Fungi, Animals, Plants) full audit logs, optionally uses DeepSeek API : Filter false positives (e.g., “fung” “fungicide”, industrial “plant”) Answer 5 key questions Micheli Guide justifications Compute score (0–5) rating (Adequate → Totally Deficient) tool designed assist researchers, policy makers, conservation practitioners assessing National Biodiversity Strategy Action Plans (NBSAPs) CBD National Reports fungal conservation policy gaps.

title: An R Toolkit for the Micheli Guide to Fungal Conservation Policy Gap Assessment
text: Language support – English French keyword lists (root‑based matching, singular+plural). Flexible document input – upload .txt, .pdf, .docx, paste plain text. ‑demand keyword searches – buttons Fungi, Animals, Plants, Run . Live summary statistics – total counts percentages kingdom. Detailed audit logs – match includes: keyword group, matched text, location (page/line/paragraph), 80‑character context yellow highlighting. Industrial‑plant exclusion – automatically excludes “plant” used factory/sewage/industrial context. AI evaluation (DeepSeek) – filters false positives applies full Micheli Guide assessment. Export results – download ZIP archive CSV files frequency tables audit logs. AI hallucination counting – keyword search 100% deterministic reproducible.
